reasons.text: The label photo for this claim is identical (same sha256) to the label photo on another claim in the program, so the claim must be flagged for review under the duplicate-photo rule.
The label is legible and shows model 98527, which is a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.
The retailer is ALDI and the purchase date of 2018-01-20 falls inside the sale window of 2016-01-01 to 2019-12-31; no receipt is required for this claim.
The destruction photo shows a gray device with its power cord visibly cut, which matches the required destruction.
The label date code 2017-03 matches the typed date code; the date-code check was skipped because the program has no date-code rule.
